name: RSI formula explainer
summary: Explain Wilder RSI and, when a close series is pasted, compute a Wilder RSI value.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Average gain/loss over `period` (default 14), RS = avgGain/avgLoss, RSI = 100 − 100/(1+RS). Education plus optional arithmetic on your numbers.
